title: The Drake With the Dreadful Toothache
story: A lava-warmed cave is roaring so loudly that the whole village has moved its goats to the next valley. Mr 6 tiptoes in and finds no villain at all — just Grommelspike, a drake with a mouthful of aching teeth, snapping at shadows because it hurts to think. Mr 6 rolls up his cape and offers to brew clove-glow salve, if the drake will hold still and say "aah."
question: Grommelspike has 60 teeth, and 2/5 of them ache. Each aching tooth needs 3 drops of clove-glow salve, and every vial Mr 6 brews holds 7 drops. How many vials must he brew to treat every aching tooth?
solution: Vials: 72 ÷ 7 = 10.28..., and a part-full vial still counts, so Mr 6 brews 11 vials.
praise: Taking 2/5 of 60 first was exactly the right opening move — the finish was remembering that a leftover splash of salve still needs a whole vial.
hint: Start with the teeth that actually hurt: what is 2/5 of 60? Then count drops before you count vials.
victory: Eleven vials later, Grommelspike's grin gleams like polished obsidian, and he insists on carrying every goat back over the ridge himself — gently, one in each claw.
imagePrompt: A huge red drake sitting meekly with its jaws wide open in a glowing lava-lit cave while a small knightly numeral 6 in a blue cape dabs salve on a tooth with a long brush, warm orange light and relieved mood.
